import primitive_api as P, json

ctx = P.get_task_context()
print("ctx:", json.dumps(ctx)[:600])
obs = P.observe()
print("pose:", obs.get("agent"))
print("inventory:", obs.get("inventory"))
vis = obs.get("visible_objects") or obs.get("objects") or []
print("visible:", [ (o.get("objectId") or o.get("name")) for o in vis][:30])

# Scan for target and receptacles
scan = P.scan_scene(queries=["SoapBar", "SinkBasin", "Sink", "CounterTop"], rotations=4, include_tilts=True, remember=True)
print("scan hits:", {k: [h.get("objectId") for h in v][:5] for k, v in (scan.get("query_hits") or {}).items()})
print("all_seen:", sorted(set(o.get("objectType","?") for o in (scan.get("all_seen") or []))))

# Try picking up the soap bar
res = P.pickup_located_object("SoapBar", aliases=["Soap", "SoapBar"], support_queries=["CounterTop", "SinkBasin", "Sink"], search_budget=30, open_containers=False)
print("pickup ok:", res.get("ok"), "| pickup:", str(res.get("pickup"))[:300])
print("inventory:", P.query_inventory())
print("progress:", P.check_progress_public())

import primitive_api as P, json

r1 = P.place_held_object("SinkBasin", aliases=["Sink", "SinkBasin"], support_queries=["CounterTop", "Faucet"], search_budget=14)

    # Step 2: run faucet on then off
    t_on = P.toggle_located_object("Faucet", aliases=["Faucet"], on=True, support_queries=["SinkBasin"], search_budget=10)
    print("faucet on ok:", t_on.get("ok"), "|", str(t_on.get("toggle"))[:160])

    print("faucet off ok:", t_off.get("ok"), "|", str(t_off.get("toggle"))[:160])
    print("soap state:", str(P.query_object_state("SoapBar"))[:300])
    # Step 3: pick soap back up
    r2 = P.pickup_located_object("SoapBar", aliases=["SoapBar"], support_queries=["SinkBasin"], search_budget=12, open_containers=False)
    print("pickup ok:", r2.get("ok"), "|", str(r2.get("pickup"))[:200])
    print("inv:", [o.get("objectId") for o in P.query_inventory()])

print("check:", P.check_success())

import primitive_api as P

SOAP = "SoapBar|-00.13|+00.95|+01.67"

def vis(q):
    return sorted([(o["objectId"], round(o["distance"], 2)) for o in P.detect_objects(q)], key=lambda t: t[1])

def try_put_in_sink():
    sinks = vis("SinkBasin")
    print("sinks:", sinks)
    if not sinks:
        return None, {"valid_action": False, "error": "no sink visible"}
    sid = sinks[0][0]
    r = P.put_object(SOAP, sid)
    print("put:", r.get("valid_action"), str(r.get("error"))[:100])
    return sid, r

# step closer to the second sink / counter
P.move_ahead()
print("pose:", P.observe().get("agent"))
sid, put = try_put_in_sink()
if not put.get("valid_action"):
    P.look("down")
    sid, put = try_put_in_sink()
if not put.get("valid_action"):
    P.move_ahead()
    print("pose:", P.observe().get("agent"))
    sid, put = try_put_in_sink()
if not put.get("valid_action"):
    P.rotate("right")
    print("pose:", P.observe().get("agent"))
    sid, put = try_put_in_sink()

inv = [o["objectId"] for o in P.query_inventory()]
print("inv:", inv)
if not inv and sid:
    fa = [o for o in P.detect_objects("Faucet") if sid in (o.get("parentReceptacles") or [])] or P.detect_objects("Faucet")
    print("faucets:", [(o["objectId"], round(o["distance"], 2)) for o in fa])
    if fa:
        fid = fa[0]["objectId"]
        r_on = P.toggle_object(fid, on=True); print("on:", r_on.get("valid_action"), str(r_on.get("error"))[:100])
        r_off = P.toggle_object(fid, on=False); print("off:", r_off.get("valid_action"), str(r_off.get("error"))[:100])
    print("check after clean:", P.check_success())
    pk = P.pickup_object(SOAP)
    print("pickup:", pk.get("valid_action"), str(pk.get("error"))[:100])
    if pk.get("valid_action"):
        ctrs = vis("CounterTop")
        print("counters:", ctrs)
        if not ctrs:
            P.look("up"); ctrs = vis("CounterTop"); print("counters2:", ctrs)
        if ctrs:
            pc = P.put_object(SOAP, ctrs[0][0])
            print("put counter:", pc.get("valid_action"), str(pc.get("error"))[:120])

                pc = P.place_held_object("CounterTop", obj=SOAP, aliases=["CounterTop"], search_budget=10)
